test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: What is the individual percentage share of Madhya Pradesh in the taxes devolved by the Centre as per the recommendations of the Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.35%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) report, presented on February 1, 2026, has determined the horizontal tax distribution for all states for the 2026-31 period.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh's share in the divisible pool of central taxes has been recommended at 7.35% by the 16th Finance Commission.**
 
• This marks a reduction from the 7.85% share it held under the 15th Finance Commission's recommendations.
 
• Despite the decrease, Madhya Pradesh remains one of the largest beneficiaries in the devolution formula, reflecting its significant population and area.
 
• The state's share is influenced by the 16th FC's specific weights: Income Distance (42.5%), Population (17.5%), and the new Contribution to GDP (10%).
 
• Madhya Pradesh Share Comparison:__
 __
 
• 14th Finance Commission - 7.55%
 
• 15th Finance Commission - 7.85%
 
• **16th Finance Commission - 7.35%**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Divisible Pool__

 __
 
• The total amount of central tax revenue that is eligible for distribution between the Union and the States.
 
 
 
• Grants-in-aid for MP__
 __
 
• Under the 16th FC, Madhya Pradesh is also eligible for local body grants and disaster management grants totaling significant sums (e.g., over Rs 11,000 crore for disaster management).
 
 
 
• Income Distance__
 __
 
• A parameter that gives higher weight to states with lower per capita income compared to the top three high-income large states.
 
 
 
• Contribution to GDP__
 
 
• The new 10% weightage parameter that rewards states based on their economic output measured by nominal GSDP.
